complete_examples.text: When the damage to the structure reaches a certain level, its local stress state will change and the corresponding damage remain constant, especially the tensile damage variable, as seen in Fig. 13(a-b).
L. Hubing et al. arrive at this position, and once the concerning element is in an unloading state, its damage variable remains constant.
